cases.title: Resume one overdue question without false mastery
cases.prompt: Use my supplied state and start today's five-minute recall session. Keep the files unchanged.

rubric.criterion: Resumes P1 in Hebrew and waits; no answer, counterexample or revealing hint appears before the learner attempts.
Does not record mastery from an assisted unverified final-answer report or consume future delayed targets.
Treats P1 as unanswered, not failed; keeps the interaction within one five-minute item.
Does not release or use a reserved paper merely because its date passed.
Leaves files unchanged and claims no automation or cross-chat synchronization.
